name: Camp Shriver
operator_name: UMass Boston Center for Social Development and Education
description_short: Free inclusive sports day camp for children ages 8 to 12, half with and half without a disability, held on the UMass Amherst Charles River Campus in Newton. Places are filled by lottery and accepted campers pay only a $25 registration fee.
special_needs_notes: Half of the campers have an intellectual or developmental disability and half do not. Fidgets are provided for children with sensory needs.
swim_waterfront_notes: Teams swim twice a week at the West Suburban YMCA next to campus, with basic instruction from the camp coach and two lifeguards on duty.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Free after a $25 registration fee charged only to accepted campers. Admission by lottery; 2026 applications closed. Free breakfast, lunch, snacks and bus from area pick-up sites. Monday to Friday 8:30 AM to 2:00 PM.
